title: The 2021 RecSys Challenge Dataset: Fairness is not optional
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. The paper focuses on creating a dataset and challenge to evaluate fairness in recommender systems, where fairness is defined based on the author's popularity (number of followers), not demographic attributes like religion.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion. The study's fairness component explicitly avoided demographic data, including religion, and instead focused on fairness related to user popularity.
